finalCta.paragraph: History: The EP6FDT is the latest evolution of PSA's Prince engine family, co-developed with BMW. In the 308 Hybrid 225, it produces 180hp from the combustion engine alone, combined with an 81kW electric motor for a total system output of 225hp. The engine is mated to an 8-speed e-EAT8 automatic gearbox with an integrated electric motor.
